brief:
Egyptian construction companies have surveyed damaged sites across southern Gaza for a housing initiative called "Green Rafah," according to Egyptian sources who spoke to Middle East Eye. The scope and timeline of the project remain unclear from the available information.

The surveying activity marks a potential step toward reconstruction efforts in the Gaza Strip, though no details about funding, implementation plans, or displacement implications have been disclosed by the companies or Egyptian authorities involved.
dek: Egyptian construction firms surveyed sites in Gaza for 'Green Rafah' project, sources say Egyptian construction firms surveyed sites in the ruins of the southern Gaza Strip for a housing project dubbed "Green Rafah", Egyptian sources have told Middle East Eye.
title: Egyptian firms survey Gaza ruins for Green Rafah housing project
